info.name: OpenRegister Register Resolver
info.description:
# OpenRegister Register Resolver

Newman skeleton covering the canonical `<context>_register` / `<context>_schema` resolver contract surfaced through OR's existing CRUD endpoints (no dedicated resolver REST surface — the design treats the resolver as a pure PHP service consumed via DI; the Newman collection here verifies the underlying `IAppConfig` keys and register/schema lookup endpoints the resolver depends on resolve consistently from HTTP).

Covers:
- happy path: configure a `theme_register` IAppConfig key and resolve the register via the standard `/api/registers/{slug}` endpoint
- misconfigured app id (404 via the register endpoint when the slug doesn't exist)
- wrong-tenant access (multitenancy-filtered 404)

Unit-level coverage (request-scoped cache, organisation override, `enumerateAppConfigs`, `MissingConfigException` shape) lives in `tests/Unit/Service/RegisterResolverServiceTest.php`.

The resolver is verified end-to-end at the service layer via PHPUnit; the Newman skeleton documents the canonical HTTP touchpoints consumer apps reach through after going via the resolver.
